description: 'Quality Minus Junk': profitable, safely financed companies earn more than their price implies. Proxy: rank of return on equity minus rank of debt to equity. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Quality · high ROE, low leverage · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen 2019, AQR) · long/short
